issue_context.title: tomorrow.io / Climacell time zone issue
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I am having a problem with my Climacell/Tomorrow.io weather data. At 8 PM local, when UTC changes to the next day, I no longer see the current day’s data. My weather cards start showing, for example, Sunday’s data even though it is still Saturday for me. In the custom card you can see that the name of the day is still as it should be, but the data has shifted. In the HA built-in weather card, it loses the current day high/low data, so it changes to showing precipitation instead, and the days shift forward.

I first installed the Climacell integration in HA Core 2021.5.5, but I was only using pollen data at that point.  I started looking at the daily forecast in more detail in HA Core 2022.2 .  This problem has always existed for me, through all following HA core updates. All my time zone settings appear to be correct. I am running HA Container on an Ubuntu Server host in a Proxmox VM.

Before UTC day change, prior to 8 PM local time on Saturday:
![Climacell Daily Day](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/51857150/172059764-bdff81fe-2a8a-40dc-831e-69a89bd17352.jpg)

After UTC day change, after 8 PM local time, still Saturday in my time zone:
![Climacell Daily Night](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/51857150/172059771-1f17e420-7d97-4395-a09f-5f4aaf814c8f.jpg)

Example of data in Dev-States (prior to 8 PM local; at 8PM local the first day under forecast changes to the following day.  (This screenshot was done Sunday morning, so not on the same day as the other screenshots):

![dev states](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/51857150/172060316-9ac66de3-0da8-42e4-80fd-3493e6826ded.jpg)

HA System Health:

![System Health](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/51857150/172059781-91b7ea8a-aac9-4b9d-9ed7-9ce6075d708f.JPG)

In the template editor:

![template_editor_light](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/51857150/172059789-1812472f-3553-4345-8ae2-485ef4fbbf74.jpg)

Inside the container:

![docker-exec](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/51857150/172059798-538b492c-1419-4ab6-9838-230addfbc6b0.jpg)

Ubuntu host:

![timedatectl_ubuntu](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/51857150/172059804-009cb59e-2d18-40de-945a-d1e352e7100e.jpg)

Proxmox:

![timedatectl_proxmox](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/51857150/172059814-df9c4010-0ec8-44b9-a07e-c3ac367819f5.jpg)





### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2022.5.5

review_comments:
AFAICT, there is no guarantee that the data is for the same time zone as the instance's configured timezone.  I expect you might want data for a location that isn't your home.

It would be a better check to throw out data that is X hours older than now instead of in the previous day.
I think this fix is fine for now though as it should solve the most common case.
